automatic_filename.grammar: exact literal 'Advanced Search(Service Request)' + exactly 14 ASCII digits YYYYMMDDHHMMSS + '.xlsx'
automatic_filename.matching: case-sensitive anchored full filename; no trim, fuzzy match, substring family guess, wildcard family guess or collision suffix

timestamp.validation: strict Gregorian YYYYMMDDHHMMSS; malformed date/time is ineligible
timestamp.meaning: automatic source-population chronology only; never an SR Report Date, Last Update, SLA instant or Objective scheduling instant

rules: automatic discovery inspects only direct stable regular non-reparse files in the configured Advanced Search inbox
newest selected candidate is validated; invalid newest candidate fails visibly and automatic discovery never falls back to an older workbook
filesystem mtime, collision-like suffixes and workbook internal timestamps never replace the embedded automatic chronology

manual_selection.rule: operator may explicitly select one local .xlsx outside the configured inbox; the path still passes the shared XLSX/path/reparse/stability security boundary
manual_selection.filename: manual preview may inspect a safe file whose physical name does not match automatic grammar
manual_selection.publication_chronology: ordinary publication/checkpoint comparison requires a usable supported Advanced Search population chronology. In Beta 1.0 the supported chronology is the valid embedded ADVANCED_SEARCH_SR_V1 filename timestamp; manual input lacking it remains SOURCE_CHRONOLOGY_UNRESOLVED and cannot publish authoritative population/checkpoint/domain acceptance.
prohibitions: row Last Update is not population chronology

operational_time_semantics.rule: operational cell timestamps remain distinct from Asia/Shanghai filename chronology and from the selectable Objective timezone

discarded_fields.rule: always discarded after staging security/header classification; never retained as SourceObservation field and never drives Contract, Product Line, CPL, product family, Network Element, Device Reference, SLA or Inventory authority

rules: SRNo is the only universally required usable row identity
missing optional-active/deferred headers produce coverage findings and never clear prior accepted values
column order is irrelevant; duplicate semantic headers block workbook interpretation
unregistered headers are discarded after bounded security scanning and do not enter logical fingerprint or reconciliation

controlled_vocabularies.unknown_nonblank: warning evidence only; cannot overwrite a previously recognized canonical status

controlled_vocabularies.rule: source-specific exact normalized value must resolve through the accepted severity registry used by LLD-06; unknown nonblank remains warning evidence and never guesses/fuzzy-maps to a severity
controlled_vocabularies.closure: exact canonical source token set is pinned before LLD-04 returns review_ready

field_semantics: Current Handler is source-owned current-assignment text. A usable newer accepted observation may change it; an accepted blank may clear the source-assignment display only. It never creates competing locally authoritative handler text.
Current Handler and Customer Contact may seed reviewed Contact reconciliation but never silently create, merge, select or re-affiliate a Contact.
Customer Account Code is preferred Customer Organization matching evidence; labels are descriptive candidate evidence only.
Suspend Planned End Date represents active suspension context only when accepted status is Customer Agreed Suspend and the end is a valid future instant under the consuming as-of context.

Suspension Duration is cumulative source-reported duration and is never inferred between workbooks. Blank parses as source-reported exact zero; a new blank/zero contradicting accepted nonzero evidence requires review before erasure.
ResolveBy and Resolve By Suspend are retained as future-use provenance only and cannot drive Beta 1.0 SLA/risk/expiration/notification/workflow.
evolution: Any filename/header/timezone/vocabulary/field-authority grammar change creates a new immutable profile or registry version; historical ImportRuns preserve the exact versions used.
